resources.string: Jev compares recognized text with its original image. It runs on this phone and does not replace your chat model.
Optional download: about 1.95 GB. Images and text stay on this phone during checking.
Delete the downloaded model files? You can download them again later.
Leaving this page pauses downloading or stops checking. Incomplete downloads can be resumed.
Choose an image of one line or paragraph, or crop it with the edge sliders below. Paste the OCR text. Tables and formulas are not supported.
Higher scores mean the text is more likely to match the image. This score has not been calibrated for this phone and OCR input; it is not proof that a phone action succeeded.
Download failed. Check your network and try again; downloaded parts are kept.
Model files did not pass verification. Please download them again.
Not enough storage. Free up space and try again.
Not enough available memory. Close other apps and try again.
The checking engine could not run. Please try again.
The selected image could not be read. Please choose another image.
Choose a text-region image and enter 1–1000 characters of OCR text.
Checking timed out. Try a smaller image or shorter text.
Local Jev checking is not supported on this device.
Reused a recent result from this visit to the page; the model was not loaded again.
There are too many lines. Use one line or paragraph of text.
Current resources pass the initial checks. Actual performance must be assessed on this phone.
Another local text check is running. Please try again later.
No usable text was recognized. Adjust the region or enter text manually.
